description: Held-out golden questions for text-to-SQL. Written and scored before any prompt tuning, and never used to tune the schema card, exemplars, or repair loop: golden.json is the development set, this file measures whether those changes generalise. Same grading as golden.json.

questions.question: What was the Buffalo Bills' pass rate in neutral game script in 2021?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT avg(is_pass_call::INT) AS pass_rate FROM plays WHERE season = 2021 AND posteam = 'BUF' AND is_designed_play AND is_neutral_script

questions.question: Which team had the highest run rate on designed plays in 2020?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT posteam FROM plays WHERE season = 2020 AND is_designed_play GROUP BY posteam ORDER BY avg((NOT is_pass_call)::INT) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What is the success rate of fourth-down attempts since 2018?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT avg(success::INT) AS success_rate FROM plays WHERE season >= 2018 AND down = 4 AND is_designed_play

questions.question: How many drives in 2022 started at or inside the offense's own 10-yard line?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM drives WHERE season = 2022 AND start_yardline_100 >= 90

questions.question: Which game had the most combined points in 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT game_id FROM games WHERE season = 2023 ORDER BY total_points DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which receiver caught the most touchdowns in 2022?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT player_name FROM player_game WHERE season = 2022 AND role = 'receiver' GROUP BY player_name ORDER BY sum(touchdowns) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Which rusher had the best EPA per play in 2023 among those with at least 150 rushing plays?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT player_name FROM player_game WHERE season = 2023 AND role = 'rusher' GROUP BY player_name HAVING sum(plays) >= 150 ORDER BY sum(epa_per_play * plays) / sum(plays) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: Compare EPA per play from shotgun versus under center on designed plays in 2024.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT shotgun, avg(epa) AS epa_per_play FROM plays WHERE season = 2024 AND is_designed_play GROUP BY shotgun ORDER BY shotgun

questions.question: How many home games did the Oakland Raiders win in 2015?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM games WHERE season = 2015 AND home_team = 'LV' AND home_margin > 0

questions.question: How many designed runs did the Titans call on first down in 2020?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT count(*) FROM plays WHERE season = 2020 AND posteam = 'TEN' AND down = 1 AND is_designed_play AND NOT is_pass_call

questions.question: What was the league-wide EPA per play in the red zone in 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT avg(epa) AS epa_per_play FROM plays WHERE season = 2023 AND field_zone = 'red_zone' AND is_designed_play

questions.question: Which team converted the most fourth downs in 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT team FROM team_game WHERE season = 2023 GROUP BY team ORDER BY sum(fourth_down_conversions) DESC LIMIT 1

questions.question: What share of drives ended in a punt in 2023?
questions.reference_sql: SELECT avg((drive_result = 'Punt')::INT) AS punt_share FROM drives WHERE season = 2023

questions.question: Compare the pass rate on early downs with later downs in 2023.
questions.reference_sql: SELECT is_early_down, avg(is_pass_call::INT) AS pass_rate FROM plays WHERE season = 2023 AND is_designed_play GROUP BY is_early_down ORDER BY is_early_down
